source_diagnosis.failed_assumption: OSM target centroid plus KartaView camera coordinate, heading, and horizontal FOV did not establish that the named storefront occupied the returned pixels.
source_diagnosis.interpretation: This is an observation-reachability/source-admission failure. It is not an OCR, character normalization, appearance, or router failure.
source_diagnosis.no_resampling: Freeze both Jakarta rows and their neighbourhoods. Do not walk farther in either opened sequence, substitute a nearby named object, or tune the geometry after seeing pixels.
source_diagnosis.next_information_source: A new KartaView city/cohort must add source-side facade/sign visibility authority before target selection, such as provider object/sign detections with exact frame geometry, an independently frozen street-side facade interval, or a query-independent visibility annotation. Point-bearing geometry alone is no longer admissible.

provider_capability_scout.documented_public_mcp: The official FAQ documents a public mcp-karta-view server with nearby_photo and object_search tools for public community imagery; private object-search data requires a Karta token.
provider_capability_scout.current_codex_tool_exposure: No KartaView, OpenStreetCam, nearby_photo, or object_search callable tool is exposed in the current task tool catalog.
provider_capability_scout.resume_action: After the requested pause, preflight the official open-source mcp-karta-view package inside E:/codex-tools without opening another target cohort. Admit it only if it can return source-side public sign/object evidence with exact photo IDs and reproducible metadata receipts.
provider_capability_scout.boundary: Documentation of a provider capability is not proof that the capability is currently callable, public for the needed object class, accurate, or sufficient for target visibility.
